result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, I'd recommend **Linear** if you're building a tech or SaaS company, and **ClickUp** if you want an all-in-one project management platform.

The best choice depends on your startup's stage, team size, and how you work. You want something that is easy to adopt, affordable, flexible, and doesn't create unnecessary admin.

## My top 5 project management tools for startups

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent for product roadmaps, bugs and sprints.
- Clean, fast interface.
- Great for developers and product teams.
- Less suited to managing every business function.
  
  [Visit Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Dashboards: Build custom reports you can actually work from | ClickUp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/7--5qp5synzBaglxadXwGdIMCdbaFt3KwHkKkJNg7RTc6Z-9h2jNcaPsgUnIeOvSAtk2HXXQMHEBIBv-U9Fq_KtVc32EO3p3lauJCgLThaNnM9-8vOw8JT7GgiopMybXXtzEPqWsAp0RcubN3Zv3GdSnK__3TuPQiH178_-nNgdQ1MBi18wfvuk2Ju77wZ18?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-rounder)

- Tasks, projects, docs and goals.
- Dashboards and automation.
- Highly customisable.
- Can feel overwhelming if overconfigured.
  
  [Visit ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Create streamlined project management workflows using database automations](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uLJA0eLnf2u0Kzuk6hCeEW5DWG43jACd950zvqWY2baRXbmVnN25cgIbQVOG0SKS14itFvDGdlUwBuLnNcAoujKdCk5Y3HFwEwX04OQOJBTzT74YHQ0hHbEbQbh__4R4atcTz338_yYfmYt2HvTlEM7aG61qM-2RyZFUCSNEPVp7LiJ2zI-KPtP3neFOEvZI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

- Great for company knowledge bases.
- Project tracking and documentation together.
- Excellent for early-stage teams.
- Less powerful for complex project execution.
  
  [Visit Notion](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![Aplicativo de gestão de fluxos de trabalho • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tLOKE3s4X0XJFCDQQe_Eyj1nBtDbu2U3CAEqZ6dByRYA-HO34UNPP424DkUULEbwTY_hCZdVWhaKHs6F0Fype_8pYfdHpPR_4YhZGxfJ4Sj0SgCf0BoBXqjDD8Huz4qHY6ywV0rnOJhMAwHjElc4KRDZzClXlaUHlhra-njZCg2HqNanHsMHD1o2pKQd_29g?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Excellent for cross-functional teams.
- Clear task ownership and deadlines.
- Good project reporting.
- More structured than some early startups need.
  
  [Visit Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![Monday Vibe | Build Custom Apps with Vibe Coding & AI Prompts](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dZbPOy2ExCYPWkRUN-y8aNBArPHAy5RJyF2Fv3kOH8r0onm7GzQMtNgFLnlF_orijMr1L_hlS3rZ5CmII7wcg1sC5QIg6R8JlCgddpaNU2x9UGq4FrFp6DOJXu4JvN0TyREqPyEMky1tg6L3RhInST4tHJiMa0BGxgH61Ibvrnb8NABR1soD10zbitKXa9pg?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Monday.com**

- Great visual dashboards.
- Marketing, sales and operations workflows.
- Strong automation capabilities.
- Can become expensive as the team grows.
  
  [Visit Monday.com](https://monday.com/)

## My recommendation by startup type

| Startup situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| SaaS / technology | Linear |
| Early-stage, 2–5 people | Notion |
| General startup, 5–20 people | ClickUp |
| Marketing / services startup | Asana |
| Operations-heavy business | Monday.com |
| Very tight budget | Trello |
